founder.message: Hey - I'm Aaryan, founder of Click T Pvt. Ltd. Clickt is designed and built by Click T and we also build custom software for different organizations as well. Write to us any time at clickt@click-t.com - I read every message.

hero.heading: Start free. Bring your whole team.
hero.lead: Every plan includes Teams, Builder, Presentation, and Checklist on iPhone, iPad, and Mac. Android for Clickt is currently shown as a coming-soon preview.

companyEdition.heading: One initial setup. A workspace ready for your team.
companyEdition.body: Each paid company workspace has a one-time initial setup fee, scaled to the level of administration and onboarding your team needs. After that, you pay only the per-user monthly subscription.
companyEdition.note: Private distribution, a separately branded app, dedicated infrastructure, and custom integrations are optional services quoted only when your organisation needs them.

free.label: Free
free.tagline: The complete Clickt workflow for individuals, students, and very small teams.
free.feature3: ClicktAI Copilots with your own API key
free.feature4: Builder: PNG, DOC, PPT · Presentation: HTML, PDF

business.label: Business
business.period: per licensed user / month · billed annually · no limit on team size
business.tagline: One connected company workspace for teams that want to plan, assign, analyse, and present without adding another AI bill.
business.feature2: Any team size - no member cap
business.feature3: Company workspace on iOS, macOS and Android
business.feature5: Clickt-provided AI: Top up AI credit anytime in $5, $10, $15, or $20
business.feature6: Managed backups, monitoring, and company administration
business.feature8: Admin and team management across all company devices

vs.label: What your Business subscription funds

business.workspace: Shared company workspace across every supported device
business.ai: Clickt-provided AI, assigned per user by admin

vs.note: Clickt-provided AI is governed by the selected supported model and your organisation’s usage policy. Your admin assigns it to the specific users whose work needs it - it isn’t switched on for every seat by default. Extra usage is topped up in $5, $10, $15, or $20 increments - always billed in USD, even on NPR pricing - or separately approved; never an automatic unlimited-usage promise.

guarantee.heading: Try Clickt with your team for 90 days.
guarantee.body: If a first-time Business customer cancels in writing within 90 days of paid service starting, Clickt will refund 75% of the first annual software subscription - the unused nine months. The initial company setup, consumed or committed AI usage, taxes, custom implementation, and third-party distribution costs are non-refundable.
guarantee.note: One guarantee per organisation. Your account must be in good standing and have completed onboarding. This is a commercial guarantee; the final order form controls if it differs.

q1.question: What is included in the Free plan?
q1.answer: The Free plan includes the full Clickt workflow - Teams, Builder, Presentation, Checklist, and Calendar - for individuals and small teams. You can use every ClicktAI Copilot by connecting your own AI provider API key in Settings. All core exports are available.

q2.question: What is a company workspace?
q2.answer: Business gives your organisation its own shared Clickt workspace, with company administration and one connected workflow across iPhone, iPad, and Mac, at any team size. Android is currently a coming-soon preview. The one-time initial setup covers onboarding and workspace preparation. A private app, separate branding, or dedicated infrastructure is optional custom scope - not a requirement to begin.

q3.question: Can I start on Free and upgrade later?
q3.answer: Yes. Start with Free, run your first workflows, and upgrade when your team needs organization controls, centralized AI management, stronger governance, API access, or webhooks.

q4.question: How does Clickt-provided AI work?
q4.answer: Business includes Clickt-provided AI, but it is not switched on for every seat by default. Your admin assigns it to the specific users whose work needs it, with organisation-level usage controls. Actual request capacity varies with the approved model, prompt length, attachments, and output size. Clickt does not silently create unlimited charges: your organisation can top up AI credit in $5, $10, $15, or $20 increments - always billed in USD, regardless of your regional pricing - approve additional usage, or use its own supported provider credential.

q5.question: What does the 90-day guarantee cover?
q5.answer: It is for first-time Business organisations only. Cancel within 90 days of paid service starting and Clickt refunds 75% of the first annual software subscription, representing the unused nine months. The initial company setup, used or committed AI usage, taxes, custom work, and third-party costs are excluded because they are incurred during provisioning.

q6.question: Why are Nepal and international prices different?
q6.answer: Clickt offers local pricing for organizations based in Nepal to reflect local market conditions. This page automatically shows NPR in Nepal and USD elsewhere. Contact us if you have questions about your region.

q7.question: Is Clickt available on Android?
q7.answer: Android for Clickt is coming soon. Visit the Google Play Store preview to see the Android workspaces being prepared for release.

enterpriseCta.heading: Need something custom?
enterpriseCta.body: For large organizations with deployment, identity, support, security, or integration requirements, talk to us directly. We'll define and price the right setup for your team.

hero.title: Privacy Statement
hero.lead: Clickt is committed to keeping your information private, minimal, and under your control. This statement explains what we collect, why we collect it, and what you can do about it.
hero.body: Clickt is a product of Click T. Pvt Ltd. ("Clickt", "we", "our", "us"). References to "Clickt" throughout this statement and across click-t.com refer to Click T. Pvt Ltd.

section1.heading: What we collect
section1.body: We collect only what is necessary to run Clickt on iPhone, iPad, and Mac.
section1.item1: Account details you provide - your name and email address when you sign up.
section1.item2: Workspace content you create - tasks, checklists, workflows, Builder datasets, Presentation decks, and team collaboration activity.
section1.item3: Essential technical data required to keep the app working correctly, such as error logs and performance signals.
section1.callout: We do not collect advertising identifiers, sell your data to third parties, or build profiles for ad targeting.

section2.heading: How we use it
section2.body1: Every piece of information we collect is used for one clear purpose: making Clickt work well for you.
section2.item1: To provide core functionality and keep your workspace in sync across devices.
section2.item2: To support collaborative features - task assignments, team updates, shared checklists.
section2.item3: To maintain security, reliability, and app performance.
section2.item4: To respond to support requests and resolve technical issues.
section2.body2: Where applicable law requires us to state a legal basis for processing, we rely on: performance of our contract with you (providing the Clickt service you signed up for); your consent (for example, when you connect your own AI provider key); and our legitimate interest in operating, securing, and improving Clickt in a way that does not override your own rights and interests.

section3.heading: Data sharing
section3.body1: We do not sell your personal information. Data may be processed by trusted service providers only where necessary to operate Clickt - for example, secure cloud infrastructure, data-storage partners, and the AI providers described below.
section3.body2: Business uses Clickt's managed shared SaaS infrastructure with organization controls. Dedicated databases or private-cloud deployments are optional custom options, individually scoped in the customer's agreement.

section4.heading: ClicktAI and third-party AI providers
section4.body1: ClicktAI Copilots work within each module. When you send a request, the relevant content from that module - and only that content - is sent to an AI provider to generate a proposal. No action is applied to your workspace until you review and approve it.
section4.body2: On the Free plan, you connect your own AI provider API key. Your requests are then governed directly by that provider's own terms and privacy policy, and Clickt does not control how that provider handles your data once your request reaches it. On Business, your organization's administrator assigns a Clickt-approved AI provider to the users whose work needs it. In both cases, Clickt does not store or transmit your AI provider credentials beyond what is needed to process each request.
section4.body3: We select AI providers who commit contractually not to use your workspace content to train their general-purpose models, and we require the same commitment from any provider we add in the future.
section4.body4: AI-generated suggestions may be inaccurate, incomplete, or unsuitable for your purpose. You are responsible for reviewing every proposal before approving it - Clickt does not warrant the accuracy of any AI-generated content. See our Terms of Service for the full acceptable-use terms covering ClicktAI.

section5.heading: International data transfers
section5.body: Clickt's infrastructure, and any third-party AI or cloud providers we use, may process and store data in a country other than the one you access Clickt from. Where required by applicable law, we rely on appropriate safeguards - such as standard contractual clauses or an equivalent transfer mechanism - for any transfer of personal data across borders.

section6.heading: Data retention
section6.body: We keep your information only for as long as needed to provide the service, meet legal obligations, and resolve disputes. You may request deletion of your account and associated data at any time by contacting support.

accountDeletion.heading: Delete your Clickt account and data
accountDeletion.intro: You can permanently delete your Clickt account and associated data at any time.
accountDeletion.step2: Open Settings, then choose Delete account.
accountDeletion.step3: Enter your current password and confirm the deletion.
accountDeletion.requestHeading: Request deletion if you cannot sign in
accountDeletion.requestBody: Email clickt@click-t.com from the email address associated with your account. Use the subject “Account deletion request” and include your username or account email. Do not send your password. We may ask for information needed to verify that the request is yours.
accountDeletion.dataBody: We delete your authentication account, profile and username, account-private workspace content, device tokens, notifications, and related private records. We remove your membership from shared workspaces. Shared workspace records needed by other members may remain, but they are no longer linked to your deleted account.
accountDeletion.retentionBody: Deletion is permanent once completed. We retain only information that we are required to keep by applicable law, and only for the legally required retention period.

dataDeletion.heading: Request deletion of specific data
dataDeletion.intro: You may request deletion of specific account data without deleting your Clickt account.
dataDeletion.step1: Email clickt@click-t.com from the email address associated with your account.
dataDeletion.step2: Use the subject “Data deletion request” and include your username or account email.
dataDeletion.step3: State which data you want removed, such as your profile details, a task, checklist, Builder dataset, presentation, or other account-private workspace content. Do not send your password.
dataDeletion.outcome: After verifying the request, we delete the requested account-private data where technically possible without deleting your account. Shared workspace records needed by other members may remain. We retain only information that we are required to keep by applicable law, for the legally required retention period.

section7.heading: Children's privacy
section7.body: Clickt is not directed at children under 13 (or the minimum age required by your local law, if higher), and we do not knowingly collect personal data from a child below that age. If Clickt is used for a school or class project, it should be used through a school-issued account or with parent/guardian permission where local law requires it. If you believe a child has provided us with personal data, contact us at clickt@click-t.com and we will delete it.

section8.heading: Security and incident response
section8.body: We use reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect your data, including encryption in transit and access controls on our infrastructure. No system is perfectly secure. If a breach affecting your personal data occurs, we will notify affected users, and any regulator required by law, without undue delay.

section9.heading: Your choices
section9.item1: You can request access to, correction of, or deletion of your account data.
section9.item2: You can sign out or delete your account from within the Clickt app.
section9.item3: You can contact us at any time with privacy-related questions or concerns.

section10.heading: Changes to this statement
section10.body: We may update this statement as Clickt's features, AI providers, or legal obligations change. We will reflect changes with an updated "Last updated" date above, and where a change is material, we will notify Business administrators directly.

section11.heading: Contact us
section11.body: For privacy questions, data requests, or support, reach us at clickt@click-t.com. We will respond within 1–2 business days.

intro.heading: Get the most out of Clickt
intro.summary: From your first workflow to team execution and polished deliverables - this guide shows you what each module does and why it saves you time.
intro.searchHint: Jump straight to the section you need.

userGuide.noResults: No matching sections found. Try a broader keyword.

startPaths.heading: Where to start 🔗
startPaths.intro: Not sure which part of Clickt to open first? Pick the path that matches what you're trying to do.

card1.heading: I need to build a report or analysis
card1.body: Start in Builder - import your data, create charts and tables, then push everything into Presentation for a clean, shareable export.

card2.heading: I need to coordinate my team
card2.body: Open Teams, assign tasks with clear ownership, and track what's open versus done - all in one place, visible to everyone who needs it.

card3.heading: I have a simple list to manage
card3.body: Checklist is the fastest way to capture and tick off items - synced across all your devices when you're signed in.

card4.heading: I want AI to handle the setup
card4.body: Each module has its own ClicktAI Copilot. Ask it to prepare your analysis, draft slides, or summarize tasks - then approve the result before anything changes.

builder.heading: Builder 🔗
builder.subtitle: Turn raw data into polished deliverables
builder.intro: Builder takes you from messy spreadsheets or exported data all the way to a finished chart, table, or slide-ready output - without needing a separate tool for each step.

tab1.heading: Import your data
tab1.body: Bring in CSV, TXT, or JSON files. Builder reads your dataset and shows you exactly what was imported - rows, columns, and a preview - so you can confirm before doing anything else.
tab1.tip: Tip: You can load multiple datasets in one workspace and switch between them as you work.

tab2.heading: Build your analysis
tab2.body: Create X-Y plots, bar charts, scatter plots, filtered tables, derived columns, and grouped summaries. Use Quick Preset to get a sensible starting configuration in seconds rather than building from scratch.
tab2.tip: Tip: Derived columns let you calculate new fields directly inside Builder without editing your original file.

tab3.heading: Deliver clean outputs
tab3.body: Load your charts and tables onto the canvas, arrange the layout, then export as PNG, DOC, or PPT - or send directly to Presentation for a polished deck. Use Polish All to apply consistent visual finishing before export.
tab3.tip: Tip: Sending to Presentation lets you combine Builder outputs with custom slides without re-importing anything.

presentation.heading: Presentation 🔗
presentation.subtitle: Build decks that look finished
presentation.intro: Presentation is where your work becomes something you can actually share - a clean slide deck ready for a meeting, a client, or a team update.
presentation.item1: Build your deck: Create slides, set titles and body text, add images, and reorder everything by dragging.
presentation.item2: Apply your brand: Set template rules, color schemes, and typography once - Presentation applies them consistently across every slide.
presentation.item3: Preview before you export: See exactly how each slide looks in-app before committing to a file.
presentation.item4: Export for sharing: Output as HTML or PDF depending on how you plan to present or distribute.

exportsCallout.body: Where do exports save? On iPhone and iPad, exports go to the Files app. On Mac, you choose the destination folder.

teams.heading: Teams & Tasks 🔗
teams.subtitle: Keep work assigned, visible, and moving
teams.intro: Teams brings your collaborators into one shared workspace. Every task has a clear owner, and everyone can see what's done versus what still needs attention - no separate status-update thread required.
teams.item1: Create a team and invite members by sending a membership request.
teams.item2: Assign tasks directly to people so ownership is never ambiguous.
teams.item3: Use YES / NO decision invites when you need a fast group response - members reply in one tap and you see the outcome immediately.

status.openBody: Task is active and assigned to someone.
status.completedBody: The assignee marked the task done.
status.decisionBody: A decision invite - members vote and you see the result instantly.

checklist.heading: Checklist 🔗
checklist.subtitle: Your personal progress tracker
checklist.intro: Checklist is the fastest way to capture what needs to get done and see your progress as you go. It syncs automatically when you're signed in, so your list is the same whether you're on your phone, tablet, or computer.
checklist.item1: Add, edit, and reorder items in seconds.
checklist.item2: Mark items complete as you finish them - or reopen them if plans change.
checklist.item3: Clear completed items with a single action to keep your list clean.
checklist.item4: Team assignments that come through Tasks appear here too, so everything is in one place.

clicktai.heading: ClicktAI Copilots 🔗
clicktai.subtitle: AI that prepares work - you decide what gets applied
clicktai.body1: Every module in Clickt has its own AI Copilot that understands that module's context. Builder Copilot works with your datasets. Presentation Copilot works with your slides. Teams Copilot works with your tasks. Checklist Copilot works with your items.
clicktai.body2: You ask, the Copilot prepares a suggestion, shows you exactly what will change, and waits for your approval. Nothing is applied until you say so.

free.heading: Free plan
free.body: Connect your own AI provider API key in Settings. You can use any supported provider - the key stays on your device and the Copilots use it on your behalf.

business.heading: Business
business.body: Your organization admin assigns Clickt-provided AI to the users whose work needs it. If you've been assigned access, Copilots work immediately when you sign in - no setup needed on your end.

exports.heading: Exports 🔗
exports.intro: Clickt can export your work in several formats depending on the module:
exports.item1: Builder: PNG, DOC, PPT, or directly to Presentation.
exports.retryTip: Use the format provided by your workspace: Builder exports PNG, DOC, and PPT; Presentation exports HTML and PDF.

settings.heading: Account & Settings 🔗
settings.intro: Everything that controls your account and AI setup lives in Settings.
settings.item2: Security: Reset your password or sign out from all devices.
settings.item3: AI Copilot key: On the Free plan, add your AI provider API key here to enable Copilots across all modules.
settings.item4: Account deletion: Delete your account and all associated data from within the app.
settings.item5: Help links: Access support, privacy, and terms pages directly from Settings.

notifications.heading: Notifications 🔗
notifications.intro: Clickt sends push notifications to keep you in the loop on team activity - without you having to check the app constantly.
notifications.item1: Someone sends you a team membership invite
notifications.item2: A team member responds to an invite
notifications.item3: A task is assigned to you
notifications.item4: A task you assigned is completed
notifications.item5: You receive a YES / NO decision invite
notifications.item6: Someone replies to a task thread
notifications.troubleshootTip: If notifications aren't arriving: Check that Clickt has permission to send notifications in your device settings and that you are signed in.

troubleshoot.heading: Troubleshooting 🔗

item1.summary: Export failed or produced a blank file
item1.body: Retry the format supported by the workspace: Builder exports PNG, DOC, and PPT; Presentation exports HTML and PDF. Confirm content is fully loaded before exporting.

item2.body: Confirm Clickt has notification permission in your device settings and that you are signed in to your account.

item3.summary: Can't assign tasks or use team actions
item3.body: Task assignment and decision invites require an accepted team membership. Make sure the person you're trying to include has accepted their invite. Some actions - like deleting a team - are only available to the team creator.

item4.body: On the Free plan, make sure you've added a valid AI provider API key in Settings. Check that the key is active and has remaining quota with your provider. On Business plans, contact your admin to confirm the organization's AI credential is configured.

item5.body: Sync requires an active internet connection and a signed-in account. Sign out and sign back in if sync appears stuck. For Checklist specifically, use the refresh action to pull the latest cloud state.

troubleshoot.contact: Still stuck? Write to Clickt Support - include your device, OS version, and a quick description of what happened.

hero.heading: Software built around your organization.

mobile.title: Mobile Applications

ai.title: AI & Automation
ai.body: AI-assisted workflows, document and data processing, natural-language interfaces, classification, automation, and AI integrations where they create real business value.

integrations.title: Integrations & System Extensions

battery.body: An internal R&D platform built at Johnson Energy Storage: structured data capture across every test stage (cathode, anode, electrolyte, cell assembly, pre-test procedures) into a canonical MySQL schema, with filterable and manually configurable tables per research team. A grid-style dashboard showed every battery under test with a live performance grade; selecting one or several cells opened detailed graphs and data for side-by-side comparison. A prediction model fed directly into that grading system for a clearer read on performance and future trajectory, alongside a simulator for modeling different process and prediction scenarios, and a historical tab for pulling up and comparing past batteries.

hero.heading: Security & Trust
hero.body: Straight answers to the questions an IT manager or procurement reviewer actually asks - not certification badges we don't hold. If something below isn't yet a self-serve feature, we say so.
hero.ctaTalk: Talk to Us About Your Requirements

dataInfra.heading: Data & infrastructure
dataInfra.lead: Where your data lives and how it's protected.

stored.a: On managed cloud infrastructure (Firebase / Google Cloud). We don't run our own data centers.

encrypted.a: Yes - encrypted in transit (TLS) between the app and our infrastructure, and at rest by default through our cloud provider.

backups.a: Our cloud infrastructure includes provider-level redundancy. We don't yet publish a formal backup SLA - if that's a requirement for your deployment, tell us and we'll scope it directly.

dedicated.a: Yes. Business uses our managed shared infrastructure with organization-level controls by default; dedicated databases or private-cloud deployment are optional, individually scoped in your agreement.

audit.a: We don't yet offer exportable audit logs as a self-serve feature. If audit trails are a requirement, contact us to discuss what's possible for your deployment.

access.heading: Access & control
access.lead: Who can see organizational data, and how access is managed.

who.a: Access is scoped to your workspace and governed by role-aware access controls - team membership and permissions determine what a given user can see and do.

sso.a: Not yet as a self-serve feature on the standard Business plan. If SSO/SAML is a requirement, contact us - it's on our roadmap for larger deployments.

delete.q: Can data be deleted or exported?
delete.a: You can request deletion of your account and workspace data at any time, or delete your account from within the app. Self-serve data export isn't built yet - reach out and we'll get you what you need directly.

ai.heading: AI & third parties
ai.lead: How ClicktAI Copilots handle your content, and who else sees it.

training.q: Is organization data used to train models?
training.a: No. We select AI providers who commit contractually not to use your workspace content to train their general-purpose models - and require the same commitment from any provider we add in the future.

providers.a: Only the content relevant to the specific request from the module you're working in - never your whole workspace. On Free, you connect your own provider key. On Business, your admin assigns a Clickt-approved provider.

disable.a: AI isn't active by default. On Free, nothing happens until you connect your own key. On Business, your administrator chooses which users have Clickt-provided AI enabled - it is not switched on for every seat automatically.

byok.a: Yes, on the Free plan. You connect your own AI provider key, and your requests are then governed directly by that provider's own terms - Clickt does not store or transmit your credentials beyond what's needed to process each request.

incident.heading: What happens during an incident?
incident.lead: If a breach affecting your personal data occurs, we notify affected users - and any regulator required by law - without undue delay. Nothing changes to your workspace without you knowing about it first.
incident.note: This page is a summary for quick reference. The full legal detail - data sharing, retention, international transfers, your rights, and how to reach us - lives in the Privacy Statement.
